what_happened: Research located the root architectural obstacle (status write precedes commit in both postflight engines) plus a safe repo-level declaration point (.claude-extensions.json top-level key survives the Lua read/write cycle unmodified) and the complementary two-part nature of GOAL (1)/(2) relative to the evidence incident, without needing web search.

The research report named exact call-site anchors (WORK (f) status write vs WORK (i) commit, the effective_file_scope_json splice, the deploy_pending_refusal isolation pattern, the sandbox test convention), so plan construction needed only confirmatory greps rather than re-exploration; every anchor cited was re-verified correct at planning time.

Phase 5 must edit agent-system/extensions/core/index-entries.json and manifest.json, both already carrying uncommitted modifications at plan time and both outside every concurrent sibling's declared file_scope (two siblings declared none at all). Flagged in the plan's Risks table with a re-read-then-explicit-file-list staging instruction rather than resolved here.
git-commit-phase.sh dropped 'agent-system/extensions/core/scripts/tests/test-gate-out-repair-reporting.sh' from a phase commit pathspec: not contained in this task's declared file_scope.
git-commit-phase.sh dropped 'agent-system/extensions/core/scripts/tests/test-gate-out-self-attribution.sh' from a phase commit pathspec: not contained in this task's declared file_scope.

Phase 5's Tier Justification/Verification literal command ('verify-deploy.sh --skip-slow --only-gate 3,4 agent-system/extensions/core') passes the extension subdirectory as TARGET_REPO, but gates 3/4 require TARGET/.claude plus (gate 3) TARGET/agent-system/extensions to co-exist, which only holds at the repo root. Ran the corrected form (TARGET defaulting to repo root) instead and reported the correction in the phase handoff rather than silently reinterpreting the plan.

Phase 6's full-gate-set requirement could not complete within this dispatch: the machine is under heavy sustained contention from multiple concurrent orchestrate sessions each running their own full verify-deploy battery at the same time. Normal unloaded baseline for the whole gate set is about 2.8 minutes; three attempts here each ran gates 1-7 successfully but stalled inside gate 8's test runner (buffered, no incremental progress visible). Cumulative wait exceeded the bounded-wait cap. All other phase 6 work (three new fixture cases, confirmed cross-engine coverage) is complete and green via targeted suite runs. Separately, during this investigation an overly broad process-kill command intended for one self-started process matched and interrupted several other concurrent sessions own verification processes (read-only tooling, no state writes); reported directly to the team lead at the time.

Phase 6's complete verify-deploy.sh gate set could not be driven to a clean exit 0: severe transient ambient system contention from an unrelated concurrent lake build (~/Projects/BimodalLogic, 10+ lean/clang processes) drove 1-min load average from ~14 to 48 during the phase, in addition to two already-known pre-existing obstructions (test-zotero-generate-export.sh hang, task 404; test-verify-deploy-context-budget.sh missing git add, task 389) and two findings already excluded by a concurrent sibling task 388 (lean doc-lint fixture registration; gate 20 eager-load +225B overage). Closed Phase 6 as COMPLETED WITH EXCLUSIONS with narrowed, fast, clean verification of every new/changed suite instead.

Task 381's postflight completion write was refused by the completion-deploy gate (exit 6): the deployed .claude/ tree was stale relative to the source store at completion time. Deferred to the next cycle's Inter-Cycle Redeploy Checkpoint to deploy and reconcile.
